summary: Validated both new features: (1) Bulk IOC Analyzer OSINT summary dialog auto-opens on Analyze click and on file upload; (2) NivX Forge Offline Investigation Report generates deterministic multi-para MDR reports honoring paragraph hints. Backend regression + new endpoint tests pass 8/8. Frontend E2E flows on /threat-intelligence and /nivx-forge validated.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 5685 lines is well past the 700-line split guideline; investigation-report + batch-summary helpers could live in a dedicated /app/backend/modules/forge_report.py for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None. All test data ephemeral (values passed inline).
context_for_next_testing_agent:
New endpoints: POST /api/iocs/batch-summary (values or results payload) and POST /api/forge/investigation-report (with paragraph hint parsing). Frontend testids to reuse: ioc-mode-bulk, ioc-bulk-input/submit/upload, ioc-bulk-summary-dialog/-text/-close/-copy; forge-investigation-report, forge-report-instructions/data/upload/enrich-toggle/generate/output/copy/download. Enrich toggle is checked by default — un-tick it for fast tests. Paragraphs in the forge output are div blocks (not

); verify via visible layout or the success toast text.
verified_flows: POST /api/iocs/batch-summary with values → 200 + summary paragraph + stats
UI: Bulk IOC paste → Analyze all → summary dialog auto-opens with paragraph, stat pills, Close+Copy
UI: Bulk IOC file upload → extracts IOCs, auto-runs analysis, auto-opens summary dialog
UI: NivX Forge Offline Investigation Report — all testids present, pre-filled instructions, uncheck enrich, Generate produces output panel with IOC pill (3 IOCS) + Copy/Download buttons
UI: paragraph hint 'in 2 paras' → 2 paragraphs rendered; 'three paragraphs' → 3 paragraphs + toast '3 IOCs · 3 paras'
